fact: The World Bank programme document of 18 September 2025 says Cote d'Ivoire has about 20 independent public data centres and no coherent hosting strategy, and the programme will fund a national cloud strategy, a data hosting classification framework and rules on cross-border data flows to safeguard data sovereignty.
title: Results Acceleration Program for Inclusive Digitalization in Côte d'Ivoire (RAPID-CI) - Phase 1
